question:
Observe the bar graph showing the number of students in different sections of a school and answer the question.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/047465356df5f9382d94fe198093d1a4f4a26766689bc07f8d81df01b002577f.png] 

Which of the sections given below has exactly double the number of students as compared to any one of the other sections?
solution:
**SOLUTION:**

According to the graph showing the number of students in different sections of a school. The lowest number of students is in section 3 which is equal to 20.

Number of students in section 3 = 20

Number of students in section 4 = 40

**∴ Four sections have exactly twice the number of students than any other section.**
